bare_s1.explanation: The unit responds to the side windows of motor vehicles, especially the cab or front door window of cars, trucks, vans and similar vehicles.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to the side windows of motor vehicles, especially the cab or front door window of cars, trucks, vans and similar vehicles.
parsed.evidence: All 20 top photos are road vehicles (fire truck, pickups, sedans, taxi, ambulances, vans, RVs), and the red boxes sit on the side or door window in nearly every case. The random photos contain no vehicles and only reach activations of 1-3.
parsed.missing_data: Photos of windows that are not on vehicles (house windows, train or bus windows) and of vehicles seen without visible side windows, to tell whether the unit codes the window itself or the vehicle as a whole.
